entry_rationale: Receive March SOFR at 4.325 to own the live US front-end of a coupon downtrend already confirmed on one-day, five-day and one-month windows. Do not pay 10s or March after 2s/5s/10s have already rallied.
entry_thesis: US two-year, five-year and ten-year yields have all fallen on the one-day, five-day and one-month windows, so the coupon downtrend is still live rather than a one-day bounce. Cash SOFR is 3.94 with March at 4.325 and September at 4.495, which still prices tightening, but that path is not permission to fade duration after a 32 basis-point two-year decline. Receive March SOFR so the listed front-end can follow the coupon move lower; dollar-yen at 157.25 is mixed across those same windows and is a weaker expression of the same impulse.

invalidation: Exit if the US two-year reclaims and holds 4.67, or if March SOFR implied prints higher while two-year, five-year and ten-year yields reverse higher together.
